spec.concept: A clear offer to request a smart contract code review, with each finding reported alongside its root cause and a recommended fix.
spec.scene: A clean navy card with a bold white headline centered on the card and a thin amber accent line beneath it. A simple abstract outline of a contract document sits at the lower right, with a small amber marker at one line to suggest a single finding. No people, no extra text.
spec.overlay_text: request a review of their smart contract code
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with white text reading request a review of their smart contract code and an amber accent line above an outlined contract document.

spec.concept: Flash loans amplify existing weaknesses, so fix the root cause rather than the loan
spec.scene: Minimal technical card on a deep navy background. A single transaction block drawn as a horizontal bar in white, with a borrow arrow entering on the left and a repay arrow leaving on the right. An amber highlighted bar inside the block marks the temporary large balance. Clean geometric lines, plenty of empty space, no figures or logos.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a single transaction bar with a borrow arrow entering, a highlighted temporary balance inside, and a repay arrow leaving, on a navy background.

spec.concept: Reentrancy: update state before making external calls
spec.scene: A calm technical card on a deep navy background. A simple diagram shows a contract box sending an arrow out to another contract and a looping arrow returning, with an amber highlight on the state update step placed before the outgoing call.
spec.overlay_text: State updates after untrusted calls allow repeated execution
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a contract calling another contract, with a looping arrow showing a callback returning before the state update.

spec.concept: Credibility through a simple, verifiable track record: completed smart contract audits from a small auditor team.
spec.scene: Clean brand card on a deep navy background with a thin amber accent line beneath the overlay text, and minimal geometric grove-like shapes in the corner. Calm, precise, uncluttered layout.
spec.alt_text: Brand image card with navy background and amber accent line, with the text 12 smart contract audits completed.

spec.concept: Unprotected Ether withdrawal caused by missing caller authorization, with a prompt to request a review of smart contract code
spec.scene: A calm, minimal vault door on a deep navy background, with a single amber keyhole glowing and a clear border of white space for the overlay text
spec.alt_text: Navy brand card with an amber keyhole on a vault door and the text Limit withdrawals to authorized parties

spec.concept: First depositor inflation attack on an ERC-4626 vault, where a direct token transfer skews the share rate
spec.scene: A calm technical diagram on a dark navy background: a vault outline holding one small share token, with a stream of tokens flowing straight into it from the side, bypassing the deposit door. Amber lines mark the inflated balance. Minimal flat style with clean geometry.
spec.alt_text: Diagram of a vault holding a single share while tokens flow into it directly, bypassing the deposit function, with the caption virtual assets and shares.
